description: Check a borrower’s situation against each Australian lender’s published rules. Returns how many lenders it fits, borrowing power, LVR, stamp duty, grants, 5% Deposit Scheme eligibility, profession LMI waivers, the fastest fixes and a link to the full interactive report.

applicants.description: One or two borrowers; the first is the main borrower

annual_base_income.description: Gross annual base income in AUD (or the equivalent if paid in another currency), excluding super

months_in_role.description: Months with the current employer, or months the ABN has been registered if self-employed

credit_score.description: Equifax-style score out of 1200, if known

lives_overseas.description: Main borrower currently lives outside Australia

loan.description: Loan amount in AUD; if omitted, savings + gift less upfront costs is used as the deposit

location.description: Capital city / regional centre, or elsewhere in the state

low_doc.description: Self-employed without two years of lodged tax returns

profession.description: Main borrower’s profession. Some lenders waive LMI for listed professions.

site.description: Which KeyReady site the report link should open

state.description: State or territory where the property is

name: assess_home_loan_readiness
title: Assess home loan readiness
